rents.range_basis: 10th-90th percentile over 56 tracts of ACS 2020-2024 rent of units built 2020 or later over all rented units
rents.evidence: python -m jobs.check_rents_acs: ACS 2020-2024 B25111 (median gross rent of units built 2020 or later) over B25064 (all rented units), median over 56 tracts with lots in Austin. Units built 2010-2019: 1.018 over 172 tracts.
rents.caveat: Census rents include long-tenure leases and utilities; no public rent rolls outside Chicago. Replace with a rent source when one is available.

property_tax.rate_note: Travis County 2026 adopted rates inside Austin ISD: Travis County 0.38621, Central Health 0.132863, Austin Community College 0.103643, Austin ISD 0.9184, City of Austin 0.579948.
property_tax.caveat: Non-homestead rate for an in-city lot; special districts some lots pay are not included.

impact_fees.basis: Austin Water capital recovery fees for a new 5/8 inch meter on a lot platted on or after October 1, 2023. The street impact fee and parkland fee are not included: see each note.

components.name: Austin Water capital recovery fee (water)
components.note: $4,800 per service unit; a 5/8 inch meter is 1 service unit, a 3/4 inch meter 1.5. Lots on plats recorded before October 1, 2023 pay less ($4,700 for 2018-2023 plats; $500 to $2,500 for plats before 2014, by zone). Apartments are charged by the building's meter size, so per-unit cost is lower.

components.name: Austin Water capital recovery fee (wastewater)
components.note: $2,900 per service unit, counted as for water ($2,500 for 2018-2023 plats).

components.name: Austin street impact fee
components.note: Not charged here: redevelopment of a previously developed lot pays only when it adds 10 or more PM peak-hour trips (about 12 houses or 18 low-rise apartments). A never-developed lot pays $850 per vehicle-mile: $2,439.50 a house inside the loop (SH 71 / US 183 / Loop 360), $3,621 outside; $1,377 / $2,048.50 per townhouse, duplex to 4-plex unit or ADU (Ordinance 20201210-061).

components.name: Austin parkland dedication fee in lieu
components.note: Not included: applies to subdivisions and site plans, not a building permit on an existing lot. Fee per unit when it applies: single family $7,647.86 (under 6 units an acre), $6,009.04 (6-12), $4,643.35 (over 12); multifamily $4,802.79 urban, $2,493.20 downtown, $2,613.66 suburban.
